title: Meta takes down a critical video about meta AI Glasses after filming at Meta
summary: Reddit users are discussing Meta's removal of a critical video about their AI-powered smart glasses, raising concerns about corporate censorship and transparency in AI product reviews.
problem_solved: Highlights potential corporate censorship issues surrounding AI product reviews and transparency concerns in the tech industry.
why_valuable: Sheds light on the tension between corporate product marketing and independent critical review of AI hardware products, which is important for consumer awareness and tech industry accountability.
